tools.name: get_organization_info
tools.description: Get information about the organization including name, unique name, status, system language, etc.

tools.name: get_devices
tools.description:
Get a list of devices for an organization using advanced search and filtering.

## Key Features
- Combine query parameters (pagination, sorting) with body parameters (filtering)
- Support for text search, field-specific filters, and complex queries
- Pagination with cursor-based navigation

## Example Usage
**Find first 5 devices for user with email "someone@gmail.com":**
- Query: limit=5
- Body: {"searchTerm": "someone@gmail.com", "searchFields": ["people.primaryEmail"]}

## Pro Tips
- **1**: Always make sure understand the definition of the fields (preset and custom fields) before using them.
- **2**: If user search devices by category: pc, phone or other, please use body.type to filter devices by category.
- **3**: Always to understand what are current sub types of the devices. If the user search information relate to sub types, Please use body.filters.["preset.subtype"] to filter devices by sub types.
- **4**: We don't really need to use searchFields parameter to the search results in all fields, only use it when the user search information relate to specific fields.
- **5**: If user want to filter devices by status, please use body.filters.["preset.status"].eq to filter devices by status.
- **5.1**: Unassigned devices status should be "in_stock" or "decommissioned".
- **6**: If user want to filter devices by preset fields or custom fields, please check the field.kind first, we only support date, number, dropdown kind of fields.
- **6.1**: If the field.kind is date, please use body.filters.["preset.field_name"].minDate or body.filters.["custom.attributeCode"].minDate and body.filters.["preset.field_name"].maxDate or body.filters.["custom.attributeCode"].maxDate to filter devices by date range.
- **6.2**: If the field.kind is number, please use body.filters.["preset.field_name"].minNumber or body.filters.["custom.attributeCode"].minNumber and body.filters.["preset.field_name"].maxNumber or body.filters.["custom.attributeCode"].maxNumber to filter devices by number range.
- **6.3**: If the preset field field.kind is dropdown, please use body.filters.["preset.field_name"].eq or body.filters.["custom.attributeCode"].eq to filter devices by dropdown value.
- **7**: Combine multiple filters examples: {"preset.status":{"eq":"active"},"preset.subtype":{"eq":"desktop_pc"},"custom.custom_xxx":{"eq":"1"},"custom.dt_13":{"minDate":"2025-12-23","maxDate":"2025-12-25"},"custom.drp_4":{"eq":"1"}}

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

sortBy.description: Sort by field. Format: `<preset | custom>.<unique field name>` or `people.displayName`

expands.description: Expand other datasets when fetching devices

peopleId.description: Filter devices by the people ID assigned to them

employeeStatus.description: Filter devices by the employment status of the assigned person

searchFields.description: Array of field names to search within when using searchTerm. Supports memo, people fields, preset fields, and custom fields

minDate.description: Only supported by fields with `date` kind

maxDate.description: Only supported by fields with `date` kind

minNumber.description: Only supported by fields with `number` kind and few special fields such as `$age`

maxNumber.description: Only supported by fields with `number` kind and few special fields such as `$age`

eq.description: Only supported by fields with `dropdown` kind

filters.description: Advanced filters. Keys look like `preset.<unique field name>`. There are certain extra virtual fields, such as `$age`

tools.name: create_device
tools.description: Create a new device for an organization. Requires device type (subtype), asset number, and model name. Can include optional preset fields and custom fields.

memo.description: Additional notes or memo about the device

fields.description: Device field values including preset and custom fields

tools.name: update_device
tools.description: Update an existing device's information. Can update preset fields, custom fields, and device properties. Note: fields.preset.asset_number, fields.preset.subtype, fields.preset.model_name are always required.

deviceId.description: The ID of the device to update

memo.description: Additional notes or memo about the device

fields.description: Device field values. Note: preset.asset_number, preset.subtype, and preset.model_name are always required

tools.name: update_device_meta
tools.description: Update device's meta information including assignment info (peopleId, status, dates) and location. Use this to assign/unassign devices to people. When unassigned, status should be 'in_stock' or 'decommissioned'. When assigned without status, defaults to 'active'.

deviceId.description: The ID of the device to update

status.description: Device status. If 'in_stock' or 'decommissioned', device will be unassigned and assignment dates cleared

peopleId.description: People ID to assign device to. Set to null to unassign. Cannot assign if status is 'in_stock' or 'decommissioned'

assignmentStartDate.description: Assignment start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Cannot set if status is 'in_stock' or 'decommissioned'

assignmentEndDate.description: Assignment end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Cannot set if status is 'in_stock' or 'decommissioned'

tools.name: get_device_custom_fields
tools.description: Get all custom fields configured for an organization's devices. Returns field definitions, types (text, date, number, dropdown), and configurations.

tools.name: create_device_custom_field
tools.description: Create a new custom field for organization devices. Defines a new field that can be used across all devices in the organization.

attributeName.description: Display label for the custom field (REQUIRED)

attributeCode.description: Unique identifier for the custom field. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores (REQUIRED)

kind.description: The type of the custom field (REQUIRED)

values.description: Dropdown items with id (stable identifier) and value (display name)

configuration.description: Dropdown configuration with values. Only required for 'dropdown' kind fields.

tools.name: update_device_custom_field
tools.description: Update an existing device custom field configuration. Can modify field name, code, visibility for device types, and dropdown configuration.

customFieldId.description: The ID of the custom field to update

visibleForType.description: List of device types this field is visible for

values.description: Dropdown items with id (stable identifier) and value (display name)

configuration.description: Dropdown configuration (values can be added, removed, reordered, or modified). Only for dropdown type fields.

attributeName.description: Display label for the custom field

attributeCode.description: Unique identifier for the custom field. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

tools.name: delete_device_custom_field
tools.description: Delete a device custom field configuration. Removes a custom field definition from the organization.

customFieldId.description: The ID of the custom field to delete. Make sure user wants to delete a device custom field and not an identity custom field

tools.name: get_identities
tools.description: Return a list of identities. Can be filtered by the status, department and type. Can also search by the email or name by keyword

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

keyword.description: Filter results by username, identityId, department name, email or displayName (prefix search)

statuses.description: Filter results by status. Accepts multiple options.

types.description: Filter results by employee type. Accepts multiple options.

managementTypes.description: Filter results by management type. Accepts multiple options.

departments.description: Filter results by departments. Accepts multiple options.

companies.description: Filter results by companies. Accepts multiple options.

locations.description: Filter results by locations. Accepts multiple options.

identityIds.description: Filter results by identityIds. Accepts multiple options.

peopleIds.description: Filter results by peopleIds. Accepts multiple options.

excludeIds.description: Exclude identities by id. Accepts multiple options.

alertTypes.description: Filter results by alert type. Accepts multiple options.

expands.description: Expand other datasets when fetching identities. Accepts multiple options.

sortBy.description: Sort results by a specific field.

sortOrder.description: Sort results in ascending or descending order.

contractStartRange.description: Filter results by contract start date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, separated by a colon.

contractEndRange.description: Filter results by contract end date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, separated by a colon.

suspensionStartRange.description: Filter results by suspension start date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, separated by a colon.

suspensionEndRange.description: Filter results by suspension end date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, separated by a colon.

createdAtRange.description: Filter results by created date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, separated by a colon.

updatedAtRange.description: Filter results by updated date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD, separated by a colon.

serviceCountFrom.description: Filter results by minimum service count.

serviceCountTo.description: Filter results by maximum service count.

customFields.description: Filter results by custom fields. For date fields, use date range format: YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD

hasHRM.description: Filter results by HRM (employee master) linkage. When true, returns only UIDs with HRM linkage.

haveAssignedDevice.description: Filter results by identities that have at least one assigned device.

haveSaasAccount.description: Filter results by identities that have at least one SaaS account.

includeActiveInternalOnly.description: When true, limits results to active employees with internal management (ACTIVE status, MANAGED/SYSTEM types only).

tools.name: create_identity
tools.description: Create a new identity in the organization. Requires employeeStatus, employeeType, firstName, and lastName. Optional: displayName, primaryEmail, department, jobTitle, employeeId, lifecycle, customFields, manager, etc.

tools.name: get_identity
tools.description: Get a single identity by ID. Optionally expand with customFieldsMetadata.

identityId.description: The ID of the identity to retrieve

expands.description: Expand other datasets when fetching the identity (e.g. customFieldsMetadata)

tools.name: update_identity
tools.description: Update an existing identity. Pass identityId and any fields to update (employeeStatus, employeeType, displayName, primaryEmail, department, jobTitle, customFields, manager, etc.).

identityId.description: The ID of the identity to update

tools.name: delete_identity
tools.description: Delete an identity by ID. Returns the deleted identity.

identityId.description: The ID of the identity to delete

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Return a list of services, along with the preview of the accounts. Can be searched by the service name by keyword

tools.name: get_service_accounts
tools.description: Return a list of accounts for a specific service. The serviceId can be obtained from the get_services tool. Can be searched by email/name of the account by keyword

tools.name: get_people_accounts
tools.description: Return a list of SaaS accounts belonging to a person. The peopleId can be obtained from the get_identities tool. Can be filtered by role, two-factor authentication, and searched by service name or workspace name

tools.name: get_identity_field_configuration
tools.description: Get identity field configuration of an organization. Returns preset field configurations, field order, available fields, fields metadata, and field details. Optionally pass an identityId to get the effective configuration for a specific identity.

identityId.description: Optional identity ID to get the effective configuration for a specific identity

tools.name: get_identity_config
tools.description: Get configuration for identity fields of a specific identity. Required to filter by a specific identityId to see the effective configuration for that identity.

tools.name: get_identity_custom_fields
tools.description: Get all identity custom fields configured for an organization. Returns field definitions, types (text, date, number, dropdown), and configurations.

tools.name: check_identity_management_type
tools.description: Check Identity management type. Use this endpoint to determine the management type for an identity based on email or identityId. Returns the management type (e.g., hr_master, manual, unregistered).

email.description: Email of the new Identity to check

tools.name: get_identities_stats
tools.description: Get identities statistics for an organization. Returns management type counts, HR master integration information, and domain lists. Use this to understand the distribution of identities across different management types and HR systems.

tools.name: merge_identities
tools.description: Merge identities in batch. Use this to merge multiple people entities or identity entities. Supports up to 50 merge operations per request. Can merge people entities (by peopleId) or identity entities (by identityId) in a single operation.

fromPeopleId.description: Source people ID to merge from

toPeopleId.description: Target people ID to merge into

merges.description: Array of people merge operations (1-50 items)

fromIdentityId.description: Source identity ID to merge from

toIdentityId.description: Target identity ID to merge into

identityMerges.description: Array of identity merge operations (1-50 items)

tools.name: unmerge_identities
tools.description: Unmerge previously merged identity/people entities. Provide peopleIds, identityIds, or both to unmerge (up to 50 items each).

peopleIds.description: List of people IDs to unmerge (1-50 items).

identityIds.description: List of identity IDs to unmerge (1-50 items).

tools.name: bulk_update_identities
tools.description: Bulk update multiple identities in a single request. Provide a list of identity IDs (1-50) and a set of field updates to apply to all of them. All identity update fields are optional.

identityIds.description: Array of identity IDs to update (1-50 items)

identityUpdates.description: Identity updates to apply to all selected identities. All fields are optional.

tools.name: get_identity_history
tools.description: Get the change history of a specific identity. Returns a paginated list of history records showing field-level changes, action types, sources, and actors.

identityId.description: The ID of the identity to retrieve history for

limit.description: Maximum number of history items to return per page. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: archive_identity
tools.description: Toggle the archive flag for an identity. Returns the updated identity with the new archive state.

identityId.description: The ID of the identity to toggle the archive flag for

tools.name: unregister_identity
tools.description: Toggle the unregistered management type for an identity. Returns the updated identity with the new management type.

identityId.description: The ID of the identity to toggle the unregistered management type for

tools.name: create_identity_custom_field
tools.description: Create a new identity custom field for an organization. Defines a new field that can be used across all identities in the organization.

kind.description: The type of the custom field (REQUIRED)

values.description: Dropdown items with id (stable identifier) and value (display name)

configuration.description: Dropdown configuration (values can be added, removed, reordered, or modified). Only required for dropdown type fields.

attributeName.description: Display label for the custom field (REQUIRED)

attributeCode.description: Unique identifier for the custom field. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores. If not provided, will be auto-generated.

serviceFieldId.description: Display label for the custom field (REQUIRED). This can be obtained as workspaceId of workspace of service field from get_services tool and user should pick a service then pick a workspace from the list of workspaces for that service and use that workspaceId for this field

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID number for the service source. This can be obtained from the get_services tool.

serviceSource.description: Optional service source to link this custom field to a specific service workspace.

tools.name: update_identity_custom_field
tools.description: Update an existing identity custom field configuration. Can modify field name and code.

customFieldId.description: The ID of the custom field to update

attributeName.description: Display label for the custom field

attributeCode.description: Unique identifier for the custom field. Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

tools.name: delete_identity_custom_field
tools.description: Delete an identity custom field for an organization. Removes a custom field definition from the organization.

customFieldId.description: The ID of the custom field to delete. Make sure user wants to delete an identity custom field and not a device custom field
